Homœoteleuton Epistrophe in verbis: ut, Est enim
hæc, judices, non scripta, sed nata lex, quam non di-

Not transcribed as [?] because the whole word reads plausibly: "Die wiederkehrung am ende" and "Die verbindung" are the likely readings. Lines are broken as printed; the paragraph beginning "Epanalepsis" continues on the next page. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
